compute_mean_score: compute the mean score from g-values and a binary mask using detector_mean.mean_score
compute_weighted_mean_score: compute the weighted mean score from g-values, mask, and optional weights using detector_mean.weighted_mean_score
test_mean_score: test the mean_score function with g-values and mask arrays of shape [batch_size, seq_len, watermarking_depth]
test_weighted_mean_score: test the weighted_mean_score function with default linearly decreasing weights from 10 to 1
review_detector_mean: review the detector_mean module containing mean_score and weighted_mean_score functions for watermark detection
